summary: Strive, Inc. filed a routine Item 8.01 current report disclosing bitcoin treasury activity and weekly holdings updates. The company purchased 1,800 bitcoin between August 24 and August 28, 2026, at an average price of roughly $79,431 per coin, inclusive of fees. Bitcoin held rose to 23,156 from 21,356; cash climbed $11.6 million to $183.5 million. Class A shares outstanding increased 3,579,147 to 83,470,035 and SATA preferred rose 803,099 to 9,073,914. No board recommendation, advisor, deal terms, or special-situation event was disclosed. Watch continued bitcoin accumulation and equity/preferred issuance funding dilution.
